verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel: 'The end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
Now the end has come for you. I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you for the way you live and pay you back for all your disgusting practices.
I will not look on you with pity or spare you. I will pay you back for the way you live and for the disgusting practices among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'
This is what the Lord GOD says: 'Disaster! One disaster after another! Look, it is coming!
The end has come! The end has come! It has woken up against you. Look, it is coming!
Doom has come on you, you who live in the land. The time has come. The day is near. There is panic on the mountains, not shouts of joy.
Soon I will pour out my fury on you and spend my anger against you. I will judge you for the way you live and pay you back for all your disgusting practices.
I will not look on you with pity or spare you. I will pay you back for the way you live and for the disgusting practices among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes you.
Look, the day is here! It has come! Doom has burst out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
Violence has grown into a rod to punish wickedness. None of the people will be left, none of the crowd, none of their wealth. Nothing of value will remain.
The time has come. The day has arrived. Let the buyer not be glad or the seller sad, for my anger is on the whole crowd.
The seller will not get back the land he sold, even if both of them live, because the vision about the whole crowd will not be turned back. Because of their sin, not one of them will save their life.
They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes into battle, because my anger is on the whole crowd.
Outside is the sword. Inside are disease and famine. Those in the country will die by the sword. Those in the city will be devoured by famine and disease.
Those who escape will flee to the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, they will all moan, each one because of their sins.
Every hand will hang limp, and every knee will be as weak as water.
They will put on sackcloth and be covered with terror. Their faces will be covered with shame, and their heads will be shaved.

They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be treated like garbage. Their silver and gold will not be able to save them on the day of the LORD's anger. It will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, because it made them stumble into sin.
They were proud of their beautiful jewelry, and they used it to make their disgusting idols and vile images. So I will make it like garbage to them.
I will hand it over to foreigners as loot, and to the wicked of the earth as plunder, and they will dishonor it.
I will turn my face away from them, and they will dishonor my treasured place. Robbers will enter it and make it unclean.
Get the chains ready, because the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
I will bring the most wicked of the nations to take over their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the powerful, and their holy places will be dishonored.
Terror is coming! They will look for peace, but there will be none.
Disaster will follow disaster, and rumor will follow rumor. They will beg a prophet for a vision. The priest will have no teaching to give, and the elders no advice.

The king will mourn, the prince will be overcome with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to the way they live and judge them by their own standards. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
